title: CNC Warmup Skipped Before Run
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cnc:job
| stats count(eval(warmup_completed=0)) as skipped_warmups by machine
| where skipped_warmups>0
| sort - skipped_warmups
description: Uses CNC job logs telemetry to monitor runs that started without a completed warmup in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for setups that may sacrifice accuracy or spindle life, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest CNC job logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals runs that started without a completed warmup so you can spot setups that may sacrifice accuracy or spindle life before it becomes annoying.
